reason: The cited evidence does not address multilayer coatings, interface-mediated dislocation blocking, or comparative creep rates. E1 reports hardness of single-layer HEA coatings, E2 discusses a different nitride system, E3 describes stress exponents in bulk HEAs without interfaces, and E4 covers nanoindentation creep in bulk refractory HEAs. None of the key premises about multilayer interface effects on creep are supported by the cited passages.
premises: Multilayer interfaces act as effective barriers to dislocation glide and climb
Sub-micron layer thicknesses (200-500 nm) provide high-density, coherent interfaces
Dislocation blocking by interfaces reduces steady-state creep strain rate
